documentation34.source: 比较电极集中到少数区域后，相对标准全头64导的采集表现。先查看已有结果，再设计布局；已有数据可直接读取，新布局按需计算。
documentation34.en: Compare how electrodes concentrated in a few regions perform relative to standard whole-head 64-channel placement. Explore existing results, then design a layout; saved data are loaded directly and new layouts are computed on demand.

documentation35.source: 选中方案后查看三维点位、实际面积和各项指标。比较前先核对实验协议、面积或半径约束，以及电极总数。
documentation35.en: Select a layout to inspect its 3D positions, actual area, and metrics. Before comparing layouts, check the protocol, area or radius constraint, and total electrode count.

documentation36.source: 依次选择允许布置范围、区域数量和每区半径上限，再点击计算。修改布局参数后，先读取匹配缓存；没有匹配记录时再运行新计算。尚未生成完整布局时，扩大半径或调整区域后重试。
documentation36.en: Choose the allowed placement area, region count, and per-region radius limit, then run the computation. Matching cached results are checked first after parameter changes. If no complete layout is found, increase the radius or change the regions and retry.

documentation37.source: 先选择符合编辑条件的已保存布局，再启用编辑模式。移动或删除电极后重新评价，原布局与编辑结果分别保存。
documentation37.en: Select a saved layout eligible for editing, then enable edit mode. Re-evaluate after moving or removing electrodes; the original layout and edited results are saved separately.

documentation38.source: 先选完整64点布局，再选择单源或多源、波形与干扰强度。比较同一场景下的标准64导、当前布局接收信号和重建结果。没有选择布局时，先完成布局选择；编辑后的减导记录不进入此实验。
documentation38.en: Select a complete 64-electrode layout, then choose single-source or multi-source mode, waveform, and artifact strength. Compare standard-64 signals, candidate observations, and reconstructions under the same scenario. A layout must be selected first; edited reduced-channel records are not eligible for this experiment.

documentation39.source: 先看场重建保留率：全头信号能还原到什么程度；再看最差10%源的幅度保留率：哪些源接收薄弱；最后看定位效用及毫米误差：能否分辨信号来源。
documentation39.en: Read field reconstruction retention first: how well whole-head signals can be recovered. Then inspect amplitude retention for the worst 10% of sources: where reception is weak. Finally, examine localization utility and errors in millimeters: how well source locations can be distinguished.

documentation40.source: 计算记录用于找回布局、参数与结果。方案对比支持报告、JSON和坐标CSV导出；实验包保留复现信息。修改最低保留要求只更新判断，不重新生成布局或信号。
documentation40.en: Use Computation Records to retrieve layouts, parameters, and results. Layout Comparison supports report, JSON, and coordinate CSV exports; experiment bundles retain reproducibility information. Changing minimum required retention updates qualification only, without regenerating layouts or signals.

documentationMetricsReading.source: 同一协议下的标准全头64导作为相对基准。信号重建衡量恢复全头信号的能力；幅度保留率（最差10%）取相对损失最大的10%源面积权重的幅度比；相对定位评分由误差换算。三者分别报告。完整公式和固定示例见“建模与原理”。
documentationMetricsReading.en: Standard whole-head 64-channel EEG under the same protocol is the relative reference. Field reconstruction measures recovery of whole-head signals; worst-10% amplitude retention averages amplitude ratios over the most affected 10% of source area; localization utility is derived from position errors. Report all three separately. Full equations and the fixed example are in Models & Methods.

roadmap.b2a9befe6dc4.en: Median and P10 of reconstruction retention, both relative to the unperturbed standard full-head 64; standard 64 is computed with the same random draws. After dropout the remaining electrodes are re-referenced to their average and the estimator is retrained. With unequal noise the typical electrode keeps the nominal noise and the estimator knows each channel's noise. Re-placement rotates the whole cap about the head centre around a random axis, with 2 mm independent jitter.

roadmap.f42682269248.en: Load covariance summaries made with eeglayoutlab eeg-summary. Each subset is recorded against one of its own channels, and a linear reconstructor fitted on the training summaries reconstructs the average-referenced signal of every shared channel; the error is the unexplained variance fraction. Raw recordings are not uploaded; the calculation runs in the browser.
